title: BAGSMART launches Blast X travel bags
summary: BAGSMART announced November 13 availability for Blast X: a 38 L travel backpack, a 38 L limited edition with a Starlight grid front panel, and a 43 L rolling backpack. The brand quotes a US collection range of USD 119.99–229.99. This is a series-level launch and price range; exact color offers, dimensions and matched photos are not yet audited.

title: Samsonite reports Q3 2026 results
summary: For July–September 2026, worldwide group net sales were USD 872.7 million, flat year over year in reported dollars and up 0.6% at constant currency. Travel-category revenue was USD 555.6 million, down 1.1% reported and 0.5% at constant currency. These are company/category revenues, not unit sales, retailer rankings or model popularity.
